summary.diagnosis:
*Oct 8→Oct 14 vs Oct 1→Oct 7* · Revenue -12% (1,105,091 vs 1,258,780 EGP) · Spend +9% · ROAS 4.84 (-19%).
   • CPC: 2.26 → 2.49 EGP (+10%, up (drag))
   • CVR: 1.09% → 1.04% (-5%, ~flat)
   • AOV: 1,246 → 1,154 EGP (-7%, down (drag))
   *Who moved it:* *CPC 44%* of the move (hurt, -21,111 EGP)  ·  *AOV 35%* of the move (hurt, -88,136 EGP)  ·  *CVR 21%* of the move (hurt, -52,961 EGP).
   *Read:* *CPC* rose +10%, the biggest of the three.
     Worth about *-21,111 EGP of spend*.
     That drove ROAS -19%.
     Revenue -12% because spend +9%.
   *Deeper:* biggest single mover was *costumes - lblb layout*, its CPC went 1.51 EGP→2.32 EGP on 7,278 EGP spend (~12% of the swing).
